translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye kedi gi joma kedo koda;
ked gi joma lawa.
Kaw kuodi gi okumbani;
aa malo mondo ibi ikonya.
Chom tongʼ ma dhoge bith mar kedo
ibwog-go joma lawa.
Wuo gi chunya kiwachone niya, “An e warruokni.”
Mad joma dwaro ketho ngimana,
ne wichkuot gi achaya.
Mad joma chanona hinyruok,
chunygi nyosre mi giweya.
Mad gichal gi mihudhi ma yamo tero,
ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye riembogi mabor;
mad yore ma giluwo bed gi mudho
bende yoregigo obed makierogi ka malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye lawogi.
Nikech gichikona obadhogi kayiem nono
kendo gikunyona bur kayiem mondo alwarie;
mad kethruok jukgi apoya ka gikia
mad obadhogi ma gisechikona makgi;
mad gilwar ei bur ma kargi lal nono.
Eka chunya nobed mamor kuom Jehova Nyasaye
kendo anabed gimor kuom warruokne.
Ringra gi chunya duto, biro hulo kawacho niya,
“En ngʼa machalo kodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.”
Ireso joma odhier e lwet joma nigi teko moloyogi,
Adier, ikonyo joma odhier gi jochan kuom joma mayogi.
Joma timo neno ma wengegi tek sudo nyime;
gipenja gik ma ok angʼeyo gimoro amora kuomgi.
Gichula rach kar ber,
kendo giweyo chunya kochwanyore.
To kane gituo magihewore to ne arwako law ywagruok
kendo ne abolora katweyo chiemo.
Kane lamona ok odwoki,
ne awuotho koni gi koni ka chunya lit,
mana ka gima aywago osiepna kata owadwa.
Ne akulo wiya ka an gi kuyo maduongʼ
mana ka gima aywago minwa.
To kane achwanyora, negichokore kaachiel gi mor;
joma ne monja nochokorena sa ma ok angʼeyo,
negisiko ka giketho nyinga.
Kaka joma ok oluoro Nyasaye chayo ji,
ne gijara ka gichano timona marach, ne gikayona lekegi.
Yaye Ruoth, ibiro siko kirango gigi katimore nyaka karangʼo?
Res ngimana kuom kethruok duto mag-gi.
Akwayi ni ires ngimana ma nengone tek e lwet sibuochegi.
Abiro goyoni erokamano e chokruok maduongʼ;
abiro paki e dier oganda maduongʼ mochokore kaachiel.
Kik iyie ni jogo osungre ni gisenyala,
joma obedo wasika maonge gima omiyo;
iyie joma ochaya maonge gimoro sigre
gi wengegi mar timona marach.
Ok giwuo gi kwe,
to gichano wacho miriambo,
kuom joma odak mos e piny.
Giyawona dhogi maduongʼ kendo nyiera ka giwachona giwacho niya, “Haa! Haa!
Wasenene gi wengewa wawegi.”
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, iseneno timgini; kik ilingʼ.
Kik ibed koda mabor, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye.
Aa malo, kendo chungi mondo ikonya!
Kedna, yaye Nyasacha kendo Ruodha.
Yala kichwaka kuom timni makare, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha;
kik iyienegi gisungre ni gisenyala.
Kik iwe giwach e chunygi niya,
“Ero, otimorene mana kaka ne wadwaro.”
Kata giwach niya, “Koro wasemuonye ngili.”
Mad ji duto mamor nikech chandruokna
oyud wichkuot kendo pachgi olal;
mad joma kaworena oyud wichkuot gi achaya.
Mad joma mor kuom loch ma imiya
okog gi ilo kod mor;
mad gisiki kagiwacho kinde duto niya,
“Jehova Nyasaye mondo otingʼ malo
nikech omiyo jatichne locho.”
Abiro pako timni makare
kendo kuom pakni duto odiechiengʼ duto.
